lines.text: The disciples ask who is greatest in the kingdom of heaven, and Jesus says whoever humbles himself like a little child.
Jesus warns that causing a little one to stumble is worse than being drowned with a millstone, and that it is better to lose a hand or eye.
Jesus says not to look down on the little ones, because their angels in heaven always see His Father's face.
A man with a hundred sheep leaves the ninety-nine on the hills to find the one that is lost, and rejoices over it equally.

wrong_details.true: he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine

lines.text: If a brother sins and will not listen privately, take one or two others, then tell it to the priests.
